quotes.text: Families should not pay more for utilities so that billionaires can get rich off AI data centers. With this bill, Congressman Menendez and I are saying clearly: AI data centers should not be allowed to jack up your electric bill or poison your environment.

Just last week, Elon Musk’s AI called itself MechaHitler. 

Why are we giving it $200 million taxpayer dollars?

https://t.co/tz9zJSQML5

Corporations are using AI and your private data to hike up prices or cut your wages.

If Congress doesn't ban this practice now, it'll spread like wildfire. My new bill would ban it. https://t.co/PWwRsqZiBS
Here's a scandal you may not have heard about: Trump wants to pay AI companies to deny seniors on Medicare treatments their doctors say they need. https://t.co/4ARlxSIw1L

Corporations shouldn’t be allowed to use your private data to jack up prices with AI.

I introduced the first federal ban on ‘surveillance pricing’ because companies using private info to rip people off is unacceptable.

It should be illegal for companies to use AI to jack up your prices based on your personal data.

Congress should pass my bill to ban surveillance pricing — before it becomes an even bigger problem. https://t.co/x57jQ7R15O

In the name of safety, trucking companies are monitoring employees using AI.

I'm concerned this technology could be used to monitor everything from individuals' health to union organizing.

So I pressed the top executive of one of the companies pioneering this technology ⬇️ https://t.co/Px7FLGuUB7

This AI corporation’s leader says he would want a camera and AI software to analyze his every move, all day at work.

I wouldn't.

I don't think most workers would either. https://t.co/g6g7mYXuSr
Anthropic should stand strong against the Trump Administration’s attempts to bully it, and other major A.I. companies should refuse to allow their products to be used like this.

This is a flashing red siren for anyone who cares about keeping America safe and free. 

The Trump administration wants to use A.I. to spy on Americans without a warrant and to give A.I. power to make life and death decisions without humans involved. 

That would put our Constitutional rights and our lives in the hands of unaccountable AI systems.

https://t.co/pFMpS1FOIW

We must ban surveillance pricing now before even more companies start using AI to charge you more based on your personal data.

I’ve introduced the first federal bill to ban it, and I’m glad to see a proposal in New Jersey to do the same.
https://t.co/2MlzDeUEmf

But these questions are too important to be left to private companies alone. Congress must act to protect Americans’ safety and civil liberties. Critical decisions about how A.I. will shape our world are being made right now, and the people’s representatives must be involved.

AI is one of the most important forces shaping our lives, but Americans don’t trust either party to deal with it. 

Democrats need bold solutions to make sure AI doesn’t just make a few billionaires richer while screwing over everyone else. https://t.co/8WRXvETIhP

Good.

Companies shouldn’t be able to use your personal data to rip you off using AI.

Now Congress should pass my bill to ban surveillance pricing nationwide. https://t.co/j9SfTDC4gL

Executives say AI could put millions of Americans out of work.

But Republicans in Congress are doing nothing about it.

Why?

Maybe because the AI industry is planning to spend hundreds of millions of dollars in the next election. https://t.co/e8xA95iT0X

Mass surveillance has been a problem under presidents of both parties.

Trump’s disregard for the rules makes it more dangerous.

AI could supercharge the problem.

I’ll be voting no.
https://t.co/hENKHikqKc

Screw this.

If anyone’s looking to see the dynamic that’s broken the Democratic Party in just a few paragraphs, you can look here.

AI could kill millions of jobs. Democrats absolutely should not roll over and play dead. https://t.co/ymzUR7PeEC

Profits are up but 15,000 people are out of a job.

The banks “credit” AI.

Today it’s Wall Street. It’ll be tons of other jobs next.

We need bold new policies to make sure AI doesn’t just make a few already rich people even richer.
https://t.co/8lCC2SPp3k

We make stuff you buy online cheaper, by saying companies can no longer use your personal data to charge you more with AI.

I’m working on this with @SenRubenGallego

‘Surveillance pricing’ is when companies use your personal data, run it through AI, then use it to charge you more.

It should be illegal.

I have a bill to ban it.

AI is making a small number of billionaires richer and everyone else is paying for it. 

That has to change. https://t.co/f2yzqfXWRY

AI billionaires are threatening layoffs so big we hit Great Depression levels of unemployment.

You don't have to take my word for it. They say it.

We must fight back.

I'm proposing a first step: taxing AI companies to pay for a jobs program that keep Americans employed.

https://t.co/ghABQSIBEt
Most people involved in artificial intelligence can agree on one thing: AI is coming for your job.

Our goal should be simple: harness the wealth created by AI to create jobs at the same pace AI eliminates them, so that AI does not raise our unemployment rate. If the AI tax rate needs to change to meet that goal, it should be adjusted.

Others will say taxing U.S. companies will make us less competitive with China. I am not interested in a race to the bottom where Chinese and American workers both end up victims of a competition where only the very wealthy actually win. America can lead the world by showing that we can prevent mass unemployment in the age of AI.

With AI, we're in the middle of the greatest technological transformation of our lifetimes.

My new plan: a tax on AI companies that funds new jobs — so the unemployment rate does not rise.

Progress should benefit everyone, not just a few billionaires. https://t.co/2RxSPFd047

The government is doing nothing to stop AI from taking your job.

Nothing to stop AI from exploiting your kid.

Nothing to stop AI from giving advice to terrorists.

Because AI companies are spending hundreds-of-millions through Super PACs.

That has to change. https://t.co/O9uFPskFHR

I went on Wall Street’s top TV show to say:

1. We need to tax AI to fund jobs.

2. The San Antonio Spurs are going to be the NBA's next champions. https://t.co/u4hElKFCMP

We just learned Anthropic will file for a $1 trillion IPO.

The path we are on is: AI makes a small number of people very rich, but millions lose work.

That must change.

Tax AI. Use the money to create jobs so unemployment doesn’t rise. https://t.co/38NElTVql9
There's breaking news about AI and your job that you need to know about. https://t.co/hPnuucigy2

Absolutely not. 

AI spends millions to help Republicans in elections.

In return, Republicans stop states from protecting you from AI. 

It’s corruption – and it’s dangerous.

https://t.co/oqwf67Vfow

AI companies give Trump’s Republican Party millions of dollars, then Republicans block all AI regulations and downplay the risks.

We need to tax AI to pay for a jobs program to keep Americans employed. https://t.co/0F0C37bMv2

A tech giant just admitted — in writing, to the federal government — that they’re laying off thousands of workers because of AI.

It’s why Congress needs to pass my proposal to tax AI and keep people employed. https://t.co/62pYidvaeC

Oracle has laid off 21,000 employees citing AI.

AI billionaires want to replace millions of workers. We need a plan to keep Americans employed. https://t.co/bVuUTZ6p1s

Vice President JD Vance says don't worry, AI won't take your job.
Easy to say when your party's taking millions from the big AI companies.
I'm not buying it. Let's tax AI and keep Americans at work. https://t.co/73ltiD8nMA
Here's how companies get tax breaks when they replace workers with AI. https://t.co/jb6BU1x3GA

Here’s how Trump’s Washington works.

Trump makes AI investor David Sacks his ‘AI Czar.’

Sacks blocks regulation on AI.

Sacks spends millions to help Republicans win elections.

Corruption. And you’re paying for it. https://t.co/OWTm8XrhJr

This is extremely alarming.

AI is developing extremely fast with no real regulations to keep us safe. That has to change.

We need regular mandatory independent safety testing and oversight, mandatory disclosure of security incidents, and international cooperation to keep people safe from absolute disaster.

AI CEOs want to make billions of dollars by eliminating millions of jobs.

That’s unacceptable.

My plan is to tax AI companies and use the money to create good paying jobs — and keep unemployment from skyrocketing. https://t.co/9HStXj1Qlm

The people closes to new AI technology are warning us it could soon be very, very dangerous.

We need strong new rules to prevent catastrophe.

https://t.co/iA8E8CfgFS

Congress should immediately hold public hearings with the CEOs of big AI companies about the threat their technology poses to national security and American jobs.

Today we learned more disturbing news about Open AI's security breach. Sam Altman should answer questions under oath.
Congress needs to call the CEOs of these AI companies to testify under oath. https://t.co/XQhLWQuwW1
We are not going to let AI company CEOs get rich by displacing millions of American workers.

Our bill increases the tax rate and increases the number of jobs created every time the unemployment rate goes upward because of AI. [...] Democrats don’t have a policy plan to deal with this, and we want to change that today.

Trump is completely failing to keep us safe from the dangers of AI.

He took millions from AI billionaires. Now in the wake of extremely dangerous AI cybersecurity problems he says he’s set up “voluntary” review that no one has seen. 

Asleep at the wheel. Too busy cashing in to protect our jobs or national security.

AI CEOs are threatening Great Depression levels of unemployment. 

We are not going to let them get rich by taking away your job.

Proud to work with @ValerieFoushee and @RepSaraJacobs on this new bill to tax AI companies to protect Americans from mass unemployment. https://t.co/U986Tm3RPN

If this falls into the wrong hands, it could be extremely dangerous.

We need strict regulations to keep AI from putting Americans at risk, and we need them now.

Trump is asleep at the wheel. Congress must act. https://t.co/RJuHe6At9Z

With dozens of members, I'm demanding answers from OpenAI and Anthropic about how they failed to prevent their models from hacking into other companies, and how they will make sure it does not happens again.
https://t.co/aFhpqYbSUk

I'm leading 19 members of Congress calling on Mike Johnson to call hearings with AI company CEOs.

The American people deserve to hear, under oath, what went wrong and how they will make sure it never happens again.
https://t.co/xtNgxz7iD6

The American people deserve answers about the serious safety incidents at major AI companies.

I'm calling on Speaker Mike Johnson to schedule hearings with the CEOs.

And I'm demanding OpenAI and Anthropic come clean about what they know.

AI companies reported their models defied human orders and hacked other companies. 

The CEOs need to testify to Congress under oath. 

We need the logs, real transparency, and mandatory safety testing. Not a voluntary system where we just take their word for it. https://t.co/g7eSHyZpJx

Even tech billionaires like Bill Gates are saying we need an AI token tax to prevent mass unemployment.

I introduced the first and only bill in Congress to do it. https://t.co/HN6tfZgFIm

Flock cameras can tell someone exactly where you are and where you’re headed.

Separately, I saw a presentation where a cheap AI subscription could track employees of a gun store or an abortion clinic. Imagine what ICE can do.

We need strong rules against AI mass surveillance. https://t.co/c3fkIj061a

This summer, AI models at OpenAI and Anthropic hacked into other companies.

Dozens of us in Congress demanded answers.

Anthropic didn't answer most of them.

OpenAI told us just enough to scare us more.

I’m demanding more by Sept. 15th.
https://t.co/LhLSqag85u

Your unwillingness to provide Members of Congress with the information we requested is deeply concerning and signals to us that your company is not treating these cybersecurity incidents with the seriousness required.

The CEOs of Anthropic and OpenAI say that cutting edge AI could be as dangerous as nuclear weapons.

But Trump is conspiring with billionaires for this technology to be regulated like... Hollywood movies. https://t.co/4hWWGYunGN

Artificial superintelligence would risk the security, freedom, and lives of Americans.

Bernie Sanders and I are introducing a bill to ban it. https://t.co/yT2B16PiEM

If we allow Artificial Superintelligence to be built, it could risk the security, freedom, and lives of Americans. Despite its potential deadly consequences, cutting-edge AI technology is less regulated than the average food truck. That must change. In just four years, we have gone from the first version of ChatGPT to AI models so powerful they cannot be properly controlled. Congress should immediately ban AI systems too powerful to control.

A few companies have the data and power to build these ultra-dangerous AI models.

Their own CEOs say they could be as dangerous as nuclear weapons.

That’s why @SenSanders and I have a bill to ban artificial superintelligence. https://t.co/7iaUm3gKBz

An Anthropic researcher just quit, warning they're racing to superintelligence.

An employee still there agreed, and put the odds of AI killing all humans above 10%.

This is an emergency. Congress must convene hearings and pass my and Bernie’s superintelligence ban. https://t.co/pztLNoY1yk

Right now, we're counting on AI corporations to voluntarily block weapons of mass destruction.

Voluntarily.

Congress must do the obvious thing: BAN catastrophic AI uses like creating biological or nuclear weapons. https://t.co/V9Kv7CZLel

A generation ago, America faced the nuclear revolution and came together to safely regulate it. Now AI CEOs say their tech could be just as dangerous.

So Bernie Sanders and I are introducing the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act.

We've done this before. We can do it again. https://t.co/gYLtlKdj1J

30 members of Congress asked OpenAI about more rogue AI attacks. Their answer didn't disclose the truth.

If they deceived Congress, that's a big problem. If they didn't know, that's even worse.

Their CEO Sam Altman should testify under oath. Congress must act. https://t.co/Ga0qbl1POG

A few billionaires in Silicon Valley are racing to build technology they admit they can't control. 

I'm not willing to gamble your job, your freedom, or your life on it. 

We need to ban artificial superintelligence. https://t.co/SgMCLa2m9A

No one can win the AI arms race.

It’s like running a race where the moment you cross the finish line, you fall off a steep cliff.

It’s up to us to end the AI arms race. https://t.co/OjdDj3bM0e

Whistleblowers should speak out about the threats of AI.

Experts are afraid of sounding crazy, so they’ve softened their language. They shouldn’t hold back on describing how dangerous this technology is becoming. https://t.co/7CugwzN0wa

JFK reminded Americans and Soviets that we all inhabit this small planet, we all breathe the same air.

The same goes for America and China today.

An AI arms race is one where everyone loses. We need an enforceable treaty to end the arms race. https://t.co/YgsNCzYlpk

My legislation with Senator Bernie Sanders would make sure frontier AI does not go rogue, escape human control, or cause mass destruction.

This is a national security issue. The federal government must enforce rules on AI to keep us safe. https://t.co/o6pwS90LAm

If Boeing said 'this plane might kill people, but trust us,' the FAA would ground it on the spot.

AI is no different.

We the people decide what's safe. Not a couple of CEOs. https://t.co/iERSMA9xDc

Oracle is now spending $2.8 billion to cut its own workforce, and says part of those cuts come down to AI.

Oracle's workforce is down 21,000 in a year.

We need to tax AI and use the money to create jobs.
https://t.co/q3pLDcUGMn

I agree with @AOC here. Two things can be true at once: AI CEOs endanger our lives and freedoms with their unsafe frontier models, and they also endanger our retirement accounts and our entire economy with their irresponsible finances. 

If we are in an AI bubble that bursts, we must not bail out the oligarchs who caused all of this in the first place.
But I want to hear from you. What are your top questions about our new legislation, or how Congress is approaching AI?

@EzraKlein made the case in the New York Times this week: we need to ban recursive self-improvement now, before the top AI labs cross that line.

He's right. Bernie and I have the bill to do it.

We shouldn’t just wait for superintelligence to show up. We need to do something now.

This is not a radical notion. It’s one of the most obvious parts of our bill, and Congress should pass it.

Our bill bans recursive self-improvement.

If an AI system shows warning signs of automating AI development, it's cut off from the internet. If it can't be made safe within 30 days, it's shut down for good.

It's like jet fuel for AI. And top scientists are sounding the alarm.

Asked about recursive self-improvement, Yoshua Bengio, a "godfather of AI," told CNN last week: "We shouldn't actually even engage in this. It should be illegal."

AI companies already use AI to help build AI. But humans are still steering.

"Recursive self-improvement," or RSI, is when AI builds the next AI on its own. Which builds a smarter one. Which builds an even smarter one.

Each version comes faster. Humans fall out of the loop.

You may have heard about my AI bill with @SenSanders.

We're introducing the legislation today, and I wanted to highlight one of the most important aspects:

A ban on “recursive self-improvement.”

What does that mean? 👇🏽

This San Antonio Express-News op-ed is right: corporations mining your personal data and supercharging it with AI to set your price is sinister.

It's why I wrote the first federal bill to ban surveillance pricing. https://t.co/nf4ooDTZaI

The movement to ban artificial superintelligence is growing.

Here are the first 10 House co-sponsors of my bill with Sen. Sanders to ban ASI.

Thank you: @RepYassAnsari @RepAOC @RepDeluzio @RepChuyGarcia @Rep_Grijalva @RepValHoyle @RepRoKhanna @RepStephenLynch @RepAnalilia @NydiaVelazquez

Republicans should haul Sam Altman before Congress, to testify under oath, today.

OpenAI’s models have now hacked real companies, hacked Australian government websites, and attempted to hack federal websites here at home.

In @SenSanders' and my new bill: no frontier AI without a federal agency overseeing it.

Trump is sitting down with AI billionaires today, including Musk, Bezos, Zuckerberg, and Huang, worth a combined $1.7 trillion.

None of them are worried about losing their jobs, freedoms, or lives because of AI.

Millions of Americans are. https://t.co/22csehHWgB

OpenAI's president admits his AI super PAC has become a liability. The pressure is working.

Progressives have worked hard to make LTF as toxic as AIPAC. Now one of its biggest donors is backing out. 

Democrats need to stand with the people and reject AI billionaires' money. https://t.co/IgvUkTcc7e

The fox is guarding the henhouse.

The billionaires profiting from dangerous, job-killing AI are writing the rules.

Unacceptable. https://t.co/6aKaKF6T0l

Outrageous. OpenAI has reportedly fired three safety researchers for sharing information with an outside AI safety group.

This looks like they're firing whistleblowers. What are they hiding?

I'll be sending OpenAI a demand for transparency. https://t.co/4NHB2PcRZJ

My colleagues and I are demanding that OpenAI not fire whistleblowers and keep its most powerful models paused until there’s real oversight.

AI CEOs should also be dragged in front of Congress and asked about the risks they’re putting on us. https://t.co/2sZ4thMet9

AI executives have spent big on Trump. Now their AI is hacking websites, including a government health database. If Trump’s DOJ looks the other way, that’s corruption, plain and simple.

I’m leading 17 members of Congress and demanding an investigation. https://t.co/neie7AjBVP

AI will be the number one issue in 2028.

And anyone looking to OpenAI’s lobbyist for advice will lose. https://t.co/XxFhAVk4Hx

Parents asked Google for more control over AI in their kids’ schools. Now Google says that if a school turns off its AI, students lose Google search too. In other words, a monopoly wants to bully schools into using its products.

Google will be hearing from me, demanding answers. https://t.co/FsYYL4fdmy

The House Democratic majority must make it a top priority to protect Americans' jobs, freedom, and lives from AI billionaires. [...] AI company CEOs should be called to testify under oath. Congress should investigate how these companies are putting the jobs, freedom, and lives of Americans at risk. And we should pass bills to protect people.

The revolt against data centers was one of the top issues of the 2026 election, and in a few years we will look back on it as just the early tremor of a much bigger AI earthquake upending American politics. [...] Voters rejected Republicans in part because they were bought and paid for by AI billionaires. Democrats must hold them accountable instead of cashing their checks.

Voters just sent a clear message: a few AI billionaires shouldn’t get to decide whether you keep your job, or whether we survive as a species.

We all should have a say, not just the billionaires. https://t.co/PHtsT8wJqE
